title: Model creature form-specific speeds, AC, and hover semantics
description:
Scope:
- Preserve statline data that depends on form or condition rather than flattening it into base speed/AC.
- Fable examples: Werewolf/Wereboar/Werebear beast-form AC, four lycanthrope form speeds, Werebear climb 30 only in bear/hybrid form, Mage/Druid spell-adjusted AC, Ankheg prone AC, and hover semantics.

Acceptance criteria:
- Creature speed/AC model can represent form-specific and condition-specific variants.
- Werebear no longer exposes climb 30 as unconditional base speed.
- Lycanthrope humanoid vs hybrid/beast speed/AC differences are represented.
- Hover is represented in a deterministic field.
- Add tests for Werebear, another lycanthrope, Mage or Druid, Ankheg, and a hover creature.
close_reason: Implemented in PR #394: speed map now carries only unconditional modes; hover emitted as literal-true field (7 creatures); lycanthrope form parentheticals emitted as speedVariants [{condition, speed}]; Werebear no longer exposes unconditional climb 30 (now {walk:30} + variant {walk:40, climb:30} in bear or hybrid form); verbatim speedSourceText kept; tests for Werebear, Werewolf, Mage, Ankheg, Ghost (hover).
